(() => {
  const result={};
  const properties=['-ms-user-select','user-select','-webkit-user-select','-moz-user-select'];
  const values=['auto','text','none','contain','all'];
  const node=document.createElement('div');
  document.body.append(node);
  node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif;display:inline-block';
  node.textContent='alpha beta';
  const plain=node.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(const property of properties){
    for(const value of values){
      node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif;width:120px;'+property+':'+value;
      node.textContent='alpha beta';
      const block=node.getBoundingClientRect();
      result['block-'+property+'-'+value]=block.width===120 && block.height===20;
      node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif;display:inline-block';
      node.innerHTML='alpha <span style="'+property+':'+value+'">beta</span>';
      const inline=node.getBoundingClientRect();
      result['inline-'+property+'-'+value]=Math.abs(inline.width-plain.width)<0.04 && inline.height===20;
    }
  }
  node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif';
  node.textContent='alpha beta';
  node.className='selection';
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');
  sheet.textContent='.selection{-ms-user-select:none;-moz-user-select:all;user-select:text;width:140px;height:18px}';
  document.head.append(sheet);
  result.sheet=node.getBoundingClientRect().width===140 && node.getBoundingClientRect().height===18;
  sheet.textContent='.selection{-ms-user-select:all;-moz-user-select:none;user-select:none;width:160px;height:22px}';
  result.mutation=node.getBoundingClientRect().width===160 && node.getBoundingClientRect().height===22;
  sheet.remove();
  result.removal=node.getBoundingClientRect().height===20;
  node.style.width='80px';
  result.resize=node.getBoundingClientRect().width===80 && node.getBoundingClientRect().height===20;
  node.remove();
  return result;
})()
